requirements.text: Treat mechanical canon integrity defects as first-class: ContractRef shape/anchor correctness, command ID validity, and section-level consistency in owner docs are required for deterministic traceability.

Architecture and runtime contracts must include explicit invariants for frozen requested/effective execution identity, projection trust versus scheduler authority, and safe-point lineage/resume validity.
OpenCode bridge limits (server-global SSE, fixed cwd, session-scoped identity/approval behavior) must be modeled as hard constraints in PM contracts unless bridge behavior changes.
Progression gates must use canonical ContractRef taxonomy and deterministic language; owner-level gate text cannot violate the same reference grammar it enforces.
GATE-010 coverage must be extended beyond flat wiring checks to validate command wrapper normalization plus route/open pass-through semantics (including route_target and OpenSubject binding).
storage-plan must normalize around attempt-native and blocked-episode identity and demote tier-keyed runtime records (tier_runtime_record, tier-keyed usage/evidence keys) from peer-canonical status.
Storage owner contracts must add first-class lane/worktree lifecycle families and align subject-first restore identity with named route/open primitives.
Prompt Pipeline must preserve requested/effective runtime field names but replace tier-scoped ownership language with run/node/attempt-scoped execution identity and override semantics.
UI Command Catalog must retire or demote stale graph HITL approval commands keyed by request_id when canonical runtime action families are blocked-sequence and run/node scoped.

FinalGUISpec must retire Tiers as primary shell/view ontology and stop treating resume_url as the primary navigation identity; it should align with graph/seam/package runtime model and canonical route/open contracts.

decisions.text: Normalize Progression_Gates as an owner doc: canonical ContractRef syntax only, duplicate addenda folded into numbered gates, deterministic normative language only, and explicit gate ties to route/open and wrapper evidence.
Adopt storage-plan normalization order: attempt-native records, blocked-projection identity, subject-first restore identity, and receipt-based cross-surface joins before consumer-level refactors.
Apply reconciliation order for GUI-drift seam: rewrite-tie-in memo first (rewrite-root routing), UI Command Catalog second (command-family cleanup), FinalGUISpec third (visible shell/view cleanup).

data_shapes.text: Canonical runtime-native storage keys include blocked_projection.{run_id}.{node_id}.{blocked_sequence}, attempt_record, scheduler_pass_record, and preview_subject_id using doc:<document_id>|artifact:<artifact_id>.

routing_rules.text: Cross-surface open/show/focus commands must be treated as canonical object navigation (not layout-only state changes) and routed through stable route/open primitives.

verification_rules.text: Gate and owner docs must pass strict ContractRef validation; syntax breaks in canonical gate text are hard integrity defects.
Duplicate addenda with conflicting or repeated canonical content are verification failures because they destabilize deterministic anchor and policy interpretation.

owner_consumer_obligations.text: Owner tranche obligations remain distributed across 22 high-impact docs, with repeated dependencies on Executor_Protocol, Crosswalk, Glossary, Orchestrator_Page, FinalGUISpec, Prompt_Pipeline, Multi-Account, storage-plan, UI_Command_Catalog, Run_Modes, Tools, Permissions, Project_Output_Artifacts, and Widget_System.
GUI and command owner docs must reconcile against Contracts_V0, Crosswalk, Orchestrator_Page, Widget_System, Run_Graph_View, and storage-plan to avoid re-amplifying stale ontology.

stale_retirement_items.text: Retire tier-era/request-era storage canon published as peer runtime truth: tier-keyed event tables, run.tier_started/completed, HITL request-era event fields, tier_runtime_record, and tier-keyed usage/evidence records.
Retire stale GUI ontology artifacts: Tiers primary view, phase/task/subtask progress framing as canonical Orchestrator model, and widgetized Orchestrator tab assumptions.

open_questions.text: Open question: what exact canonical SSE discriminator and correlation fields will be standardized to represent OpenCode session and provider-native identity parity across bridged providers?

process_defects.text: Process defect: owner docs continue to fail mechanically (duplicate sections, malformed ContractRefs, phantom command references), causing gate evasion and canon ambiguity.

doc_hints.text: Targeted reconciliation for rewrite-root and GUI drift should start with rewrite tie-in routing and command-catalog normalization before FinalGUISpec shell/view edits.
Progression gate fixes should be coordinated with DRY/Contracts/Crosswalk owner rules so verification and reference grammar are enforced by one deterministic taxonomy.
